_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Storage Manager are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `vrooli scenario generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

app.title: Storage Manager
app.description: Closed accounting, placement, retention, and safe reclaim for local storage.

dashboard.title: Storage Console
dashboard.description: See what is attributed, what is not, how much headroom remains, and which actions are safe.
